trigger_condition: A scheduled PowerShell command launches Docker through an instance Process.Start() call.
guard_snippet: if (-not $invocation.Static) { return $true } # Reject unresolved instance invocation targets.
potential_consequence: Startup verification accepts an unguarded task that can restart applications during schema maintenance.

trigger_condition: The shared audit directory is absent when security preparation first runs.
potential_consequence: The newly created directory inherits permissions, so preparation immediately rejects its own output.

trigger_condition: The shared audit root is valid but its audit mutex file is absent.
potential_consequence: Preparation succeeds with inherited mutex permissions; subsequent maintenance and upgrade checks reject the mutex.

trigger_condition: A device in an earlier page is deleted while a multi-page listing loads.
guard_snippet: Fetch subsequent pages using an immutable device-id cursor and the initial snapshot boundary.
potential_consequence: Offset pagination skips an existing device, returning an incomplete list as successfully loaded.
